text:
Jordan R.: hi team, second day here — quick request: can someone give a super-short map of who to ask for the first-week checklist? access, GPU sandbox, cost approvals, CI deploy keys, and safety review.
Priya (eng): welcome! quick list from my first week: access = infra tickets, GPU sandbox = dedicated-capacity team, cost approvals = billing/finance, CI deploy keys = eng-platform, safety = research-safety.
Jordan R.: thanks — any special notes for model-serving tests? where to run smoke jobs without hitting production quotas?
Marcus - infra: hey Jordan — use `sandbox-cluster` namespace for experiments, request quota via infra-requests and include your manager in the ticket. We usually grant low-level GPU quota for 2 weeks initially. Docs: https://internal.redwood/sandbox-usage.
Jordan R.: perfect. who signs off for temporary access to private datasets?
Lena - People Ops: dataset access needs DUA + manager OK. Reach out to Data Steward (stewards@redwood) and include a link to the eval plan. People Ops only coordinates the DUA paperwork.
infra-bot: NOTE: new-hires are provisioned with read-only prod access. To get elevated rights complete `onboarding-security` training and submit infra ticket with manager approval.
Priya (eng): also, if you need a quick who-to-ask cheat: - VPC / network & infra tickets: @Marcus (infra) - GPU sandbox & quotas: dedicated-capacity - Cost / billing / purchase orders: finance-billing - CI / deploy keys: eng-platform - Model-serving runtime questions: eng-runtime (cc me) - Safety reviews / PII questions: research-safety / data-steward
Jordan R.: this is great. last Q: if a deploy fails and it's unclear who owns the rollback, where to page?
Marcus - infra: page #eng-oncall first. If it's model-serving related, #eng-runtime will pick it up; otherwise infra oncall will triage and route. For production incidents follow the incident runbook (internal link).
Jordan R.: thanks all, saved me a ton of time. I'll open the infra ticket for sandbox quota now and DM the data steward about DUA.
